body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Haier introduced its first line of digital cameras at CES 2010.

With options and features that reduce red-eye and aid in image stabilization, Haier's digital cameras make it easy for consumers to take great photos. One simple connection allows for quick uploads of video and photos to computers, printers or online. All Haier cameras support YouTube video upload to share videos with friends and family.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
